intent: Specify the array-based LEB128 API of the `leb128fmt` crate for 32 and 64 bits: `encode_u32`, `encode_u64`, `encode_fixed_u32`, `encode_fixed_u64`, `decode_u32`, `decode_u64`, `encode_s32`, `encode_s64`, `encode_fixed_s32`, `encode_fixed_s64`, `decode_s32`, `decode_s64`. In Lean they are `leb128fmt.<name>`; arrays are `Std.Array Std.U8 5#usize` (32 bits) / `Std.Array Std.U8 10#usize` (64 bits) and results are `core.option.Option` values.

manual_mutants.note: last-byte overflow check off by one: a 10th byte of 2 is accepted and its bits are silently dropped
a final byte 0x7f (sign extension of a negative value) is rejected
final-byte sign mask for 32 bits computed one bit too high: out-of-range 5-byte values accepted / valid ones rejected
negative values stop as soon as the rest is -1 without checking the sign bit (e.g. -128 encodes as [0x00])
fixed-width encoding pads negative values with 0x80 instead of 0xFF
continuation bit not set on non-final bytes

bug_variants.note: decode_u64 no longer rejects a 10th byte whose value bits do not fit in 64 bits: the extra bits are silently dropped, so values that do not fit decode to a wrong number (documented: if the value does not fit, return None)
decode_s64 forgets to sign-extend values shorter than 10 bytes: negative numbers decode as large positive ones (breaks the encode/decode round trip)
